headline.caveat: Equity value; $25/share in cash (net of Salesforce's existing stake). Announced May 27, 2025; closed late 2025.

nature_md: Salesforce acquired Informatica for ~$8B ($25/share cash) to bolt enterprise data management — cataloging, integration, governance, master data (IDMC) — under its Agentforce agentic-AI strategy: agents are only as good as the customer data plumbing beneath them. Second-largest Salesforce deal after Slack ($27.7B), struck at a ~30% discount to Informatica's 2024 take-private talks price, and folded into the Data Cloud organization post-close.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Salesforce funded the purchase with cash and new debt; Informatica consolidates into revenue from close (adding ~$1.7B ARR), with goodwill/intangibles and integration costs against the AI-data narrative that underpins Agentforce's $1B ARR trajectory.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Informatica public shareholders were cashed out at $25/share; company delisted (NYSE: INFA) and became a Salesforce subsidiary.

sources.notes: Confirms deal closed and Agentforce context.
